title: undici vulnerable to Denial of Service via unhandled exception in the decompress interceptor (CVE-2026-87029)
description: A vulnerability in undici's decompress interceptor allows a denial of service via an unhandled exception. When the decompress interceptor forwards decompressed data to a downstream handler that throws an exception asynchronously (such as the dump interceptor with a maxSize limit), the exception is uncaught and terminates the Node.js process. This can be triggered by a malicious HTTP server sending a small compressed response that decompresses to a size exceeding the limit. The issue affects undici versions >=7.15.0 <7.30.1 and >=8.0.0 <8.12.2. Fixed in versions 7.30.1 and 8.12.2.
